name: D00_3_own_spell_untaxed
notes: Printed: 'Spells your OPPONENTS cast that target this creature cost {2} more to cast.' Seat 0 controls Boreal Elemental and casts Disfigure at it with only {B} in the pool: its own controller's spell is not taxed, so the cast resolves and the Elemental is 1/2 until end of turn.
